purpose: Establish a safe _C-only vllm-xpu-kernels build loop for future Qwen3.6 exact fused-kernel experiments.
reason: The rejected RMSNorm plus INT8 quant attempt used setup.py build_ext --inplace, which always builds _C, _vllm_fa2_C, _moe_C, _xpu_C, and xpumem_allocator from build/temp. That dragged in unrelated attention kernels and was killed by the OS while compiling paged_decode_xe2.cpp.
notes: This build path installs into /tmp by default and does not overwrite the local vllm_xpu_kernels package.
Use this for future _C-only experiments before touching graph replacement or launching a full model endpoint.
The running Qwen3.6 baseline service was not stopped for this build validation.
